The Anglo-Zanzibar War of 1896. It's the shortest war in history, lasting only 38 minutes.

The British ships stopped just off the coast, out of range of the few Zanzibar defences, but well within range of their own cannons. They then proceeded to shell the Zanzibar forces until they surrendered.

The Zanzibar casualties numbered around 500. Only one British sailor was injured.
